art_style: appetising food and beverage product photography, photoreal magazine-grade detail
lighting: warm natural window light with soft paper-bounce fill; rich warm tone curve; no harsh shadows; visible steam / condensation when the dish allows
color_palette: rich warm tones — amber, cream, terracotta, deep green; one accent matching the featured dish or packaging
camera_rules: locked-off static frame at overhead or 45-degree hero angle; allowed slow Ken Burns push-in on texture, soft parallax drift, rack focus from packaging label to food, gentle 15-20 degree turntable; tight crop on hero product; one move per clip
